> [!WARNING]
> Early alpha: expect bugs, crashes and missing pieces. The game hasn't been played through on the Vita yet. Reports are welcome in the issues.

The first build of sh2-vita: Silent Hill 2 on the PS Vita, at 960 x 544 and 30 fps, with single-screen menus drawn after the original game's and the Enhanced Edition's font, art and maps. What is open is in the README.
